title: Accidental Trigger
next_chapter_hook: The warning of the Heavenly Eye echoes in the ears, the equation of shackles and death hanging before the eyes. What does Mo Xiansheng's words 'death can also be another door' truly mean? Can Chen Ji find a third path in the crevices of fate?

text.content: In the instant golden light erupted, Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—that light burning in the puppet's hollow eye sockets was identical to the fluctuation of the fragment on his chest, frequency, rhythm, and aura all resonating in the same instant. "Not good—" Before he finished speaking, the ground beneath his feet cracked abruptly, a brilliant pillar of light shooting skyward, enveloping both him and Ye Qing. The surrounding scenery twisted violently, ruins transforming into flowing light rushing backward, as if an invisible giant hand had flipped the entire world.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's voice came through the pillar of light, carrying uncontainable shock: "Chen Ji, this is... a teleportation formation? No, it's older than teleportation formations! This is the entrance to a sealed space!" Her Demonic Path mist surged instinctively, yet was instantly repelled upon touching the edge of the light pillar. Holy Sect secret techniques were completely useless here.

text.content: When the light faded, the two found themselves in a bizarre space. The walls were all jet-black crystalline surfaces, covered with densely packed symbols that constantly reorganized and transformed, like living writing. The Tianji Record Fragment on Chen Ji's chest vibrated violently, scalding him so badly he could barely hold it—that feeling, like the nervousness before a wanderer returns home, or like a prisoner's instinctive resistance facing a cage.

dialogue.content: Suppressing the burning pain in his chest, Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, his voice low: "This space... was specially set up for me. The Tianji Record is calling for its other half, or in other words—" he paused, his gaze falling on the illusory figure slowly materializing before him, "it's calling for its master."

text.content: The phantom gradually solidified, a massive golden vertical pupil appearing out of thin air, its depths seemingly containing all the stars and void of the universe. Its gaze carried no emotion, yet made one feel a suffocating pressure of being completely seen through. That was not the gaze of a creature, but the gaze of Heaven itself—cold, objective, regarding all things with indifference.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." The voice rang out from all directions simultaneously, without distinction of male or female, old or young, only an ancient eternal calm, "You have finally arrived. All the prophets throughout history sought this place, yet none ever truly triggered it. You are the first." The golden vertical pupil contracted slightly, as if examining something, "And the most dangerous one."

Chen Ji stared directly at that vertical pupil, a cold smirk actually forming at the corner of his mouth: "Most dangerous? The Heavenly Eye personally set a trap for me, and bestows the title of 'most dangerous'—how am I worthy of such honor." He paused, shifting topics, "But I'm curious—are you not here to kill me? If you wanted to act, that pillar of light was enough to destroy my soul completely."

There was not the slightest emotional fluctuation in the golden vertical pupil: "Kill you? A foolish question. If you die, the Tianji Record will find the next host, cycling endlessly, meaningless." The voice paused, "I came to give you a choice—and a warning."

text.content: As the words fell, the symbols on the four walls changed abruptly,汇聚成 flowing images. Chen Ji saw the fates of the Tianji Record's inheritors throughout history—they died violent deaths, or went insane, or were besieged by the world, none met good ends. And behind each image, a golden vertical pupil gazed quietly.

"The Tianji Record is a chess piece." The Heavenly Eye's voice rang out again, "And I am not the chess player either. I am merely the will that maintains Heaven's operation—a rule that must exist. What you call 'antagonists' are merely variables I set to maintain balance. And you, Chen Ji—" the golden vertical pupil pressed closer, "you are the only variable in ten thousand years that might break the balance."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's heart shook violently, yet his expression remained unchanged: "Break the balance? You overestimate me. I am merely atrash servant, struggling even to reach Foundation Building." His voice carried his usual self-deprecation, yet the Heavenly Eye's next words froze his disguise instantly.

"Shackles." The Heavenly Eye uttered these two words, a trace of indescribable emotion flickering in the golden vertical pupil—was it pity? Or warning? "You think that is your cultivation defect, the price of the Tianji Record? No. That is the insurance I set." The light in the space suddenly turned blinding, "Every counterattack of the shackles is me reminding you—stop. Continue, and you will die."

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed—that laugh was bone-chillingly cold: "So that's how it is. All my suffering is your carefully arranged 'kind reminder'? How flattered I am." He stepped forward, staring directly at the golden vertical pupil, "What if I refuse to stop?"

The Heavenly Eye did not answer immediately. The images on the four walls changed again, this time showing a chaotic void, and within that void, the body of the Heavenly Eye slowly emerging. That was not a vertical pupil, but a shackle spanning ancient times—it was both the maker of rules and the rules themselves.

dialogue.content: "Heaven's cycle, cause and effect in order." The voice was no longer cold, but carried a hint of exhaustion, "If you insist on解开 the shackles, the Tianji Record will fully awaken. Then you will possess the power to rewrite fate—but the price is Heaven's cycle collapsing. A world without cause and effect's restraints, what do you think it will be?" A scene of apocalypse reflected in the golden vertical pupil, "It will be the extinction of all living things."

Ye Qing couldn't help but speak, her voice slightly trembling: "Then Chen Nian? His sister was captured by the Holy Sect to解开 some kind of seal—" she suddenly realized something, looking at Chen Ji, "could it be..."

"Chen Nian." The Heavenly Eye repeated this name, a strange fluctuation flickering in the golden vertical pupil, "That is another key. Heaven's Fate Lock Key, the name the Holy Sect gave her." Its voice lowered, "You think her capture was coincidence? No. That is my final line of defense. If one day you truly cannot be controlled, I will use her to—" it paused, as if choosing words carefully, "end all this."

text.content: These words were like a basin of ice water poured over Chen Ji's heart. His sister, used as a chip by the Heavenly Eye as the last resort? Was the truth he had searched for so many years actually this suffocating? Chen Ji's fists unconsciously clenched tight, fingernails digging deep into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers.

However, in the next instant, he suddenly looked up, his eyes already restored to clarity. That was not anger, not despair, but a cold, calculating light—he was analyzing, reasoning, seeking weaknesses. Remembering grudges without being rash, this was Chen Ji's instinct carved into his bones. The Heavenly Eye was powerful, but it had already said too much. Exposing information meant exposing weaknesses.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his voice terrifyingly calm: "So, you need me alive, but cannot let me become too strong. You need to maintain balance, but cannot directly kill me. You need Chen Nian as the terminating measure, but do not want to reach that point." A meaningful arc curved at the corner of his mouth, "Heavenly Eye, do you... also have something you fear?"

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's warning made Ye Qing's face show fear, but Chen Ji反而 laughed coldly. How will you choose to respond to this unexpected truth?

choices.description: Continue pressing the Heavenly Eye's weaknesses, turning this dialogue into a game of chess rather than mere listening.

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, approaching the golden vertical pupil, his voice like a blade: 'You speak of orderly cause and effect, of the extinction of all living beings—what if I truly don't care?' A madness flickered in his eyes. 'Chen Nian is my sister, but if saving her costs the destruction of the world...' He paused, his smile growing colder. 'Then I'll just create another world.'

choices.description: Pretend to be intimidated, preserve strength, wait for a better opportunity.

text.content: Chen Ji收敛了笑容，垂下眼睑，声音low：'……我明白了。'他的姿态放得很低，仿佛真的被这番话震慑住了。夜清slightly侧目，却见陈机的眼珠在眼睑下轻轻转动——他在记忆，在推演，在将每一个细节刻入脑海。示弱，从来都是他最擅长的disguised。

choices.description: You already left a trump card in the Tianji Record—Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. Call upon him now and demand the truth.

text.content: Chen Ji paid no attention to the Heavenly Eye. Instead, he dove his consciousness into the Tianji Record fragment at his chest, whispering: 'Mo Xiansheng, you saw it too, didn't you? Come out and say a few words?' The fragment shuddered violently. A illusory figure slowly emerged—a wizened scholar whose age was impossible to determine, the remnant soul guardian left by Chen Xuan. He glanced at Chen Ji, then at the golden vertical pupil, and sighed: '...You rascal, truly不让省心.'

The golden vertical pupil remained silent for a very long time. So long that Ye Qing thought it would never speak again, so long that Chen Ji nearly believed his provocation had fallen on deaf waters. Then, that vertical pupil moved—not approaching, but slowly retreating, withdrawing into the darkness within the crystal walls. It was... backing down?

dialogue.content: 'Chen Xuan was just like you back then.' The Heavenly Eye's voice rang out again, this time carrying a hint of... nostalgia? 'He discovered the truth, but chose not to break the balance. He chose another path—transforming himself into part of the chessboard.' The golden vertical pupil cast one final glance at Chen Ji: 'The Tianji Record will tell you his choice. If you are willing... you may walk his path.'

Chen Ji let out a cold laugh: 'Chen Xuan's path? Becoming part of the chessboard? Being manipulated to death by you?' His voice suddenly rose: 'I don't care about any Heavenly Dao cycle, don't care about orderly cause and effect. Chen Nian is my sister. Even if it means destroying the world, I will rescue her with my own hands.' His eyes burned with unprecedented fervor: 'This is my only bottom line.'

text.content: As his words fell, the runes on the crystal walls burst open. Countless specks of light danced like fireflies, converging before Chen Ji into a line of scorching characters: 'The day your shackles are removed is the day of your death.' The inscription burned his eyes, yet it seared itself unmistakably into the depths of his consciousness. This was a warning, and a prophecy—one even the Heavenly Eye could not alter.

choice.prompt: The prophecy of death hangs before your eyes, Ye Qing's face shows worry. How do you choose to respond to this inescapable fate?

choices.description: Directly deny this so-called prophecy. The fate Heaven has decreed, he will personally rewrite.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Deeper Power of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his hand, grabbing that line of scalding words. Flames burned his palm, blood dripped, but his voice was terrifyingly calm: 'My fate is in my hands, not in heaven.' The golden vertical pupil contracted violently—at this moment, it felt the threat. Not from power, but from will. A person who dared to gaze directly at the Heavenly Dao and deny destiny... was the most dangerous variable it had encountered in ten thousand years.

choices.description: Propose a trade condition—while saving Chen Nian, search for the possibility of not destroying the world.

text.content: Chen Ji released his hand and stepped back, his voice returning to its usual calm: '...I can refrain from actively untying the shackles. But regarding Chen Nian's matter, I will resolve it in my own way.' The golden vertical pupil fell silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: 'Acceptable. But remember—every 'way' you take is eroding the shackles' stability. When it shatters one day...' It didn't finish, but Chen Ji already understood. The deal was struck, but his gamble against fate had just begun.

choices.description: Reject the binary choice. Chen Nian must be saved, the shackles must remain locked, and the world must be preserved—there must be another way.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer immediately. In his mind, he rapidly deduced countless possibilities—the Heavenly Dao's Eye said Chen Nian was the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key', the means of ending everything. But what if instead of using it for ending, it could be used for... stabilization? The shackles were set to 'death upon unlocking', but what if someone could establish a new balance while unlocking? He recalled what Master Mo once said—'Death can also be another door.' Perhaps liberation doesn't equal destruction. The essence of the shackles isn't bondage, but... transformation.

The sealing space began to dissolve, the crystalline walls melting like ice layers, runes scattering as flowing light. Before the golden vertical pupil vanished completely, it cast one final glance at Chen Ji: 'You're more interesting than Chen Xuan. I hope you won't disappoint me.' As the words fell, it vanished completely, as if it had never existed.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing walked to Chen Ji's side, gazing at his bleeding palm, a hint of heartache flickering in her eyes: 'You...' She wanted to say something, but didn't know where to begin. The previous conversation carried too much information; she needed time to digest. But one thing she was certain of—this man was more insane and more dangerous than she had imagined.

Chen Ji lowered his head, looking at the burn on his palm, a self-deprecating smile curling his lips: "'More interesting than Chen Xuan'? Heh, is that supposed to be a compliment?" He raised his gaze toward the void, a complex light flickering in his eyes, 'Chen Xuan chose to become the chessboard. I...' He didn't finish, but Ye Qing already understood. He would not walk Chen Xuan's old path. He would walk his own path—even if that path led to the abyss.

text.content: The sealing space collapsed completely, and the two returned to the battlefield. Puppet remnants lay scattered across the ground, surroundings restored to dead silence. But Chen Ji knew everything was different now. He had obtained crucial intelligence—the true nature of the shackles, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's real purpose, the significance of Chen Nian as 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key', and that prophetic curse.

Ye Qing suddenly spoke, her voice gentle but firm: 'Whatever choice you make, I will stand by your side.' She paused, adding, 'The Demonic Path mist can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, which means... as long as you're willing, I can help you temporarily deceive the Heavenly Dao.' She looked at Chen Ji, her gaze carrying an unprecedented seriousness, 'This isn't cooperation—this is what I owe you.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji looked at Ye Qing and suddenly laughed—not a cold laugh, not a mocking one, but a genuine smile from the bottom of his heart: 'Aren't you afraid I might actually destroy the world?' Ye Qing shook her head: 'No.' Her answer was crisp and direct, 'Because you're not that kind of person. You talk about destroying the world, but actually...' She pointed to her heart, 'You treasure everyone here more than anyone.'

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then gently nodded: '...Thanks.' Only two words, yet they were a rare display of genuine emotion from him. Ye Qing smiled faintly, but bitterness welled in her heart—she knew the burden on this man's shoulders was too heavy, heavy enough to make her heart ache.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressed the chaotic thoughts, and returned to being that calm, self-composed waste disciple. The Heavenly Dao's Eye gave him two choices—either accept fate and become a manipulated chess piece, or resist fate and become the villain who destroyed the world. But it forgot one thing—Chen Ji never walked the path others laid out for him. The shackles would be removed, but not now. Chen Nian would be saved, but through a third path. And the Heavenly Dao's Eye... one day, he would personally reveal its cards.

Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment pulsed again. Master Mo's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, aged and distant: 'Kid, what happened today... you did well.' After a pause, he added, 'Chen Xuan took the path of 'fusion', integrating his will into the Heavenly Dao, thereby maintaining balance. But that isn't the only choice.' Chen Ji's heart stirred: 'You mean...' Master Mo's laughter echoed in the depths of his consciousness: 'Death can also be another door. Think carefully about these words.'

Chen Ji stood frozen, Master Mo's words like lightning splitting the fog in his mind. Death is another door—previously, he thought this was merely metaphorical. But now, combined with the Heavenly Dao's Eye's statement that 'the day the shackles are removed is the moment of death', he suddenly gained another understanding. What was the essence of the shackles? They were limitation, insurance, a means to prevent the Tianji Record from fully awakening. If the shackles were viewed as a 'seal', what was needed to unlock them... wasn't forced destruction, but finding 'the key to unlock'. And Chen Nian was precisely that key—the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'. What was locked was the Heavenly Dao, and the key was also the Heavenly Dao.

choice.prompt: Master Mo's hint struck like lightning. Ye Qing noticed your strange expression. How will you handle this new discovery?

choices.description: Share the speculation with Ye Qing, and let the two deduce together. Three minds are better than one agonizing alone.

text.content: Chen Ji shared Mo Xiansheng's hint and his own speculation with Ye Qing. After listening, a strange glint flashed in the saintess's eyes: "If we follow this logic... Chen Nian, as the 'key,' her role might not be to unseal the formation, but to 'transform' it." She paused thoughtfully, "The Holy Sect's purpose is to use her to end the Heavenly Dao, but what if we could change the way of this 'ending'? Not destruction, but... ascension?" Chen Ji's eyes lit up, "You mean—"

choices.description: This speculation is too critical to let more people know before verification. Even Ye Qing.

text.content: Chen Ji buried these speculations in his heart, not telling Ye Qing. Not distrust, but discoveries of this magnitude must be verified repeatedly. He looked at Ye Qing, offering an apologetic smile: "Sorry, there are some things I need to think through." Ye Qing didn't press, simply nodding lightly. Trust isn't having no reservations, but choosing to believe even while holding back. This unspoken understanding was more precious than any words.

choices.description: Since Mo Xiansheng gave the hint, he must know more. Seek his guidance directly.

text.content: Chen Ji dove his consciousness into the Tianji Record Fragment, fixing his gaze on Mo Xiansheng: "Old sir, since you know more, why not speak plainly? What does 'death is another door' mean?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long while before slowly speaking: "Every master of the Tianji Record ultimately faces a choice—to become part of the Heavenly Dao, or be devoured by it." His voice carried a trace of vicissitude, "Chen Xuan chose the former. But there is a third path—not merging, not being devoured, but... nirvana."

Night wind swept across the battlefield, dispersing the lingering scent of blood. Chen Ji stood before the puppet's remnants, gazing at the gradually brightening pale dawn, lost in contemplation. The warning from the Eye of Heavenly Dao, the truth of the shackles, Chen Nian's fate, Mo Xiansheng's hints... all these intertwined, forming a situation so complex it was suffocating. But Chen Ji had never feared complexity.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice calm yet carrying an imperceptible warmth: "Ye Qing." The saintess turned her head, waiting for his next words. "If one day I truly reach that point..." He paused, "Don't worry about me. Take your people and leave. Survive." Ye Qing was stunned for a moment, then shook her head: "Impossible." Her reply was crisp and decisive, "I've said it before, whatever choice you make, I will stand by your side. Even if it's hell."

text.content: Chen Ji looked into Ye Qing's determined eyes, a complex emotion stirring in his heart. This woman, from the initial mutual exploitation to now fighting side by side...不知不觉间，已经成了他不可或缺的存在。他张了张嘴，想说什么，最终却只是轻轻叹了口气："……走吧。还有很多事要做。"他没有说出口的话，夜清却听懂了——谢谢，以及，我会保护好你的。
两人并肩走向远方，消失在黎明的微光之中。身后，傀儡的残骸在晨风中渐渐风化，仿佛从未存在过。但陈机知道，今天发生的一切，将彻底改变他的命运。枷锁、预言、天道之眼……这些曾经模糊的概念，如今已变得清晰而heavy。他不怕死亡，但他不想毫无意义地死去。如果注定要死，那也要死得有价值——保护想保护的人，改变想改变的命运。这，才是他陈机的道。
天道之眼的warning回荡在耳畔，枷锁与死亡的等式悬于眼前。墨先生那句"死亡也可以是另一扇门"究竟是何意？陈机能否在命运的夹缝中，找到第三条路？
